zh: Mac：打开主窗口、设置或文本历史时显示 Dock 图标，可用 Dock 和 Cmd-Tab 找回窗口；关掉窗口后回到仅菜单栏。
en: Mac: VoxChord shows a Dock icon while its main window, Settings or Text History is open, so the Dock and Cmd-Tab can find it; it returns to the menu bar when they close.

zh: iPhone：修复切到后台再回来后经常卡在「搜索中」、只能划掉 App 重开才恢复的问题。
iPhone：去掉新手引导，打开即用；还没配对 Mac 时，主页直接显示官网地址，可分享或复制到 Mac。
Mac：新增自定义词库，人名、产品名、技术术语识别更准，润色时保持原有写法；词库只保存在本机。
Mac：新增文本历史，保存每一轮的原始识别与润色后的文字，可以搜索、复制，找回没输入成功的内容。
Mac：应用、安装包与广播名统一为 VoxChord，已有配对和授权不受影响。
en: iPhone: fixed the app getting stuck searching after returning from the background, which previously needed a force quit.
iPhone: the tutorial is gone and the app opens straight to Home; until a Mac is paired, Home shows the website address to share or copy to your Mac.
Mac: a custom vocabulary makes names, product names and technical terms more accurate, and polish keeps their spelling; it stays on your Mac.
Mac: text history keeps the raw and polished text of every round, searchable and copyable, so nothing that failed to type is lost.
Mac: the app, installer and network name are now VoxChord; existing pairings and permissions keep working.

zh: iPhone：连续说话较久时，主页四周会轻微收拢，边缘渐入模糊与色散；松手发送时弹回，取消时平稳恢复。
iPhone：开启系统「减少动态效果」时不做形变，改为柔和的边缘变暗。
en: iPhone: during a long recording the home screen gently closes in from the edges with soft blur and colour fringing, then springs back when you send or settles when you cancel.
iPhone: with Reduce Motion on, a soft edge vignette replaces the deformation.

zh: iMic 正式更名为 VoxChord：iPhone 主屏、像素字标、引导与权限说明，以及 Mac 菜单栏、窗口、设置和提示都换成新名称。
已有配对、Key、偏好设置与辅助功能授权继续有效，无需重新配对；iPhone 也能识别仍在运行旧版的 Mac。
en: iMic is now VoxChord: the new name and pixel wordmark appear across the iPhone home screen, onboarding and permission prompts, and the Mac menu bar, windows, settings and alerts.
Existing pairings, keys, preferences and Accessibility access keep working with no re-pairing, and the iPhone still finds Macs running the previous version.

zh: iPhone：默认固定连接上次使用的 Mac，不再自动跳到其他已配对电脑；设备页可以删除已配对的 Mac。
iPhone：从后台返回后重连更可靠；修复系统调整麦克风格式时录音被误取消。
Mac：设置保存、凭据保护、配对与识别稳定性多项修复。
en: iPhone: stays with the Mac you used last instead of jumping to another paired computer, and paired Macs can now be removed from the device list.
iPhone: more reliable reconnection after returning from the background; recordings are no longer cancelled when the system adjusts the microphone format.
Mac: fixes for saving settings, protecting credentials, pairing and recognition stability.

zh: iPhone：录音默认启用苹果语音处理，带降噪、回声消除与自动增益；麦克风失效时自动恢复，并新增 MIC TEST 自检。
iPhone：新手引导改为在真实主页上练习按住、松手和下拉发送，不开麦、不联网，可随时重播。
Mac：百炼服务地址更容易填写，并兼容新版格式的 Key。
en: iPhone: Apple voice processing (noise reduction, echo cancellation, auto gain) is on by default, a stalled microphone recovers by itself, and a new MIC TEST checks your input.
iPhone: onboarding now teaches hold, release and pull-to-send on the real home screen, offline and without the microphone, and can be replayed any time.
Mac: Model Studio endpoints are easier to enter, and newer key formats are accepted.

zh: Mac：支持自动更新，默认每天检查一次，也可以在菜单中手动检查。
Mac：百炼 Key 更容易配置，自动识别地域；设置向导改为先填 Key 再开权限。
iPhone：全新首次引导与五张交互式手势练习；两端界面跟随系统语言显示简体中文或英文。
上线全新双语官网。
en: Mac: automatic updates, checked daily by default or on demand from the menu.
Mac: Model Studio keys are easier to set up and their region is detected automatically; setup now asks for the key before permissions.
iPhone: a new first-run guide with five interactive gesture lessons; both apps follow the system language in Simplified Chinese or English.
A new bilingual website.

zh: Mac：一个百炼 Key 同时用于识别和润色；设置窗口改为分页，可安静启动、登录时启动，菜单栏可直接切换润色。
iPhone：启动、回到前台或断线后自动连接已配对的 Mac。
iPhone：修复多数时候听不到音效的问题，19 个音效重做为 8-bit 风格；待机变暗不再改动系统亮度。
en: Mac: one Model Studio key now covers recognition and polish; settings are split into tabs, with quiet launch, launch at login and polish toggles in the menu bar.
iPhone: reconnects to a paired Mac automatically on launch, on return to the foreground and after a drop.
iPhone: fixed sound effects that were often silent and remade all 19 in an 8-bit style; standby dimming no longer touches system brightness.

zh: Mac：新增首次设置向导，引导打开辅助功能并当场验证百炼 Key；安装包改用 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证。
Mac：润色扫光改为骨架屏式加载，下划线贴合真实字迹，终端里的中文定位更准确。
输入安全：输入到终端时换行会替换为空格，多行结果不会被逐行执行。
en: Mac: a new setup guide enables Accessibility and verifies your Model Studio key on the spot; the app is now Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple.
Mac: the polish highlight shows a skeleton-style loading state, underlines sit on the real glyphs, and Chinese text in terminals is located accurately.
Safer typing: line breaks become spaces in terminals, so multi-line results are never run line by line.

zh: Mac：Electron 编辑器中的实时文字改用键盘兼容模式，输入更稳定。
en: Mac: live text in Electron editors now uses keyboard compatibility mode for steadier input.

zh: Mac：润色扫光在 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 等应用中定位更稳，修复外接 1x 显示器上的错位。
iPhone：发射时从弦上崩出会冷却熄灭的方形余烬。
en: Mac: the polish highlight locks on more reliably in apps such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor, and no longer drifts on external 1x displays.
iPhone: launching text now throws off square embers that cool and fade.

zh: iPhone：全新荧光界面，提供清晰、荧光、荧光 CRT 三档显示效果。
文字转换：支持 Agent 指令、终端命令、文言文、废话文学、翻译腔五种模式，以及四种语气、四种输出语言。
修复顶部上拉清空与编辑器自动补全的干扰问题。
en: iPhone: a new phosphor interface with Clear, Phosphor and Phosphor CRT display styles.
Text conversion: five modes (agent prompts, terminal commands, classical Chinese, waffle and translationese), four tones and four output languages.
Fixed pull-to-clear and interference with editor autocompletion.

zh: iPhone：全新弹射与琴弦手势，下拉发送、上拨删字、左右移动光标、拉到顶清空。
Mac：润色扫光，在原文位置逐行显示润色过程，可以关闭。
Mac 处理期间锁定拉弦；返回前台时恢复连接更快。
en: iPhone: new launch and string gestures: pull down to send, flick up to delete, swipe sideways to move the cursor, pull to the top to clear.
Mac: the polish highlight sweeps line by line over the original text and can be turned off.
The string locks while the Mac is still working, and connections recover faster on return to the foreground.
